_comment: Settings for the Future Factories streaming RCA pipeline. Values in seconds unless named otherwise.

grasp._comment: R03 builds the rocket: it grips the base, the two body pieces (handed over by R02) and the nose cone. Its load cell reads about 1,350-1,390 with an empty gripper and 4,000-10,000 while holding a piece.

cycle._comment: A complete cycle takes about 295 s; shorter segments are the start or end of the recording or a restart.

template._comment: The expected grasps of a complete cycle: times learned from the first cycles, names commissioned from one cycle of each fault. A cycle may run a few seconds late as a whole; matching allows for that shift.

baseline._comment: A generic detector for comparison: z-scores of every sensor's per-cycle mean against the calibration cycles.
